description: Item 1 scaffold of PR #1645: tests the per-block × Plancherel-weight hypothesis for the (α_em/π)/dim H_3 form. Verifies that a 1-dim Wedderburn block carrying (α_em/π) reproduces (α_em/π)/6 under Plancherel weighting. NOT a derivation — scaffold only.

data.verdict: SCAFFOLD PASSES: per-block × Plancherel-weight hypothesis is NUMERICALLY consistent with the (α_em/π)/6 form. The structural mechanism CANDIDATE is: EM correction lives at a 1-dim Wedderburn block (sign or trivial) and propagates to the proton's mass identity with Plancherel weight P_λ = d²_λ/|S_3| = 1/6.
